description: This file is a Markdown document generated to describe the PackageInstaller plugin, including its methods, configuration, and general information within the Thunder framework.

methods.name: install

methods.description: Uninstall a package based on its package ID.

methods.description: Retrieve a list of all packages with their IDs, versions, states, and optional digest and size.

methods.description: Return runtime configuration details for a specific package, including resource limits, environment variables, and other settings.
